findings.failureScenario: The two desktop hosts (egui `apps/lightcraft` and Tauri `apps/lightcraft-desktop`) each re-implement startup policy (CLI flags, library resolution order, GPU crash sentinel, crash notice text) instead of sharing one owner, and the copies have already diverged. In the egui host `--demo` is an alias of `--memory`, which its help text describes as a throwaway in-memory session where nothing is saved. In the Tauri host, `--demo` still resolves the user's real library (from the env var, the saved path or the default) and opens it on disk with seed_demo=true (controller.rs:58-61). A user or script that relies on the documented `--demo` throwaway mode ends up opening and writing their real library when they run the Tauri build. The GPU crash notice is also duplicated word for word (main.rs:175 and native.rs:950), so a wording or guidance fix has to be made in both places.
findings.action: Move the launch-option parsing and startup policy (library resolution, demo or in-memory semantics, GPU crash sentinel and notice) into one shared owner, such as lightcraft-engine or desktop-host, that both hosts call. At minimum, give `--demo` the same meaning in both hosts.
